# Levelrail

> Open source, self-hosted deployment platform and lightweight Coolify alternative. Push to git and get a running app with HTTPS, logs, traces, metrics, previews and one-click rollback on your own Linux servers. Single Go binary, Docker runtime, built-in observability, scale to zero. Apache 2.0.

## Start here

- [Docs](https://docs.levelrail.com): hosted documentation
- [Getting started](https://docs.levelrail.com/getting-started): install and first deploy
- [Feature status](https://docs.levelrail.com/feature-status): what is stable and what is beta
- [Comparison](https://docs.levelrail.com/comparison): Levelrail against Coolify, Dokploy, CapRover, Dokku and Kamal

## Identity and access

- Sign-in: password, passkeys (WebAuthn), TOTP two-factor, OAuth with 20 providers (Google, GitHub, Microsoft, GitLab and more) and generic OpenID Connect.
- SAML 2.0 single sign-on and SCIM 2.0 provisioning exist but are beta and off by default behind the `saml-scim` feature toggle. [SAML and SCIM](https://docs.levelrail.com/sso-saml)
- Authorization: IAM Allow and Deny policies, roles, teams, scoped API tokens. Audit log with a verifiable hash chain and CSV export. [Identity and access](https://docs.levelrail.com/identity-and-access)
- [Security overview](https://docs.levelrail.com/security): secrets, sessions, node trust, deploy safety, audit log, limitations
- Template catalog: 300+ one-click services. [Catalog](https://docs.levelrail.com/template-catalog)
